limitations: Small synthetic fixtures, not general task accuracy. GPU repeats=3, initial CPU repeats=2; 4B CPU repeats=2. Native GPU resident memory is an end-of-run observation, not peak. Background workloads uncontrolled. Windows native compile/inference/PowerShell/HTTP/restart CI passed; target CPU laptop hardware unmeasured. 4B compares the same official Q8 file across CPU/GPU, not against original BF16.
measurement_note: Python rows from 20261009-114511; native rows added from separate isolated runs using identical fixtures, two repetitions, converted local Q8_0 weights. Native RSS includes Python gateway and C++ child; native CPU time omitted because those initial runs counted only parent time.
